title: Desk Extender Tray Ergonomics Desk Extender Tray Foldable Keyboard Drawer Tray
body_html:
Features:
【Ergonomic Design】The horizontal extension desk provides ample support for the arms, relaxes the upper limbs, and improves working conditions. Multiple design improvements have been made to find the best ergonomic solution.
【Excellent Space Installation】It can be folded when not in use, saving space. When in use, you can place more items such as keyboards, laptops, mice, etc., to increase the usage space.
【Easy Installation】Follow the installation instructions for quick installation. The entire process only takes 5 minutes and is very convenient. The holeless installation ensures the desk remains intact.
【Better Compatibility】This extension board is more suitable for ordinary right-angle office desktop computers than similar products on the market. It can be perfectly connected on both the side and the front of the table.
